exposure: fetal monitoring results (reactive vs. non-reactive non-stress tests)
cohort: The study included 300 primigravidae or multiparous women with singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation, all presenting with meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: Thick meconium was associated with significantly higher neonatal morbidity and a greater incidence of meconium aspiration syndrome compared to thin meconium.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were the predominant mode of delivery in cases of meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
